semiconductor_relevance: High — SiC Alliance focuses on the development and promotion of silicon carbide (SiC) technology, which is critical for power semiconductor applications.
summary: SiC Alliance is dedicated to accelerating the adoption of silicon carbide (SiC) technology in power control systems, which are essential for energy efficiency. The organization facilitates collaboration among industry, academia, and government to enhance R&D and commercialization of SiC devices, particularly in applications like electric vehicles and power grids.
capabilities: Coordination of national SiC research projects
Information sharing and collaboration on SiC technologies

regional_presence.Japan: The organization is actively involved in national projects and collaborations within Japan to promote SiC technology.
